title: Ledger row envelope
description: The common envelope every graded number in a HORIZON book carries. Ledger-specific schemas embed this for each numeric field, or apply it row-wide with a shared definition_ref per column. A value without definition_ref and grade is not admissible.

value.description: The number (or null when the source has no value for this period; never 0 as a stand-in).

definition_ref.description: Slug of the metric file in books/<client>/01-definitions/, e.g. aht-agent-work.

formula.description: Required when grade is C: the formula as applied, with the grade of each input.

range.description: Required when grade is E: the low and high of the estimate.

assumption.description: Required when grade is E: the assumption that produced the estimate.

source.description: Where the value came from: system name and pull, or the file/message it was read from.

system.description: e.g. acd, wfm, booking-platform, email, forecaster

ref.description: Pull id, file path with version, or message id

version.description: Version of the ledger file this row belongs to, v001 upward.

supersedes.description: Version this row corrects, if any. The corrected row is never deleted.

grade.description: M measured · C computed (formula stated) · E estimated (range and assumption) · A asserted (one source).

actor.description: Who wrote the row: agent:<Name> or human:<role>.
